simple.meaning: צִפּוּי (tsippûwy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “encasement (with metal).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 38:17. The surrounding context includes family, covenant.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִפּוּי (H6826) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: צִפּוּי (tsippûwy) / H6826 is traced through Exodus 38:17, Exodus 38:19, Numbers 17:3, Numbers 17:4 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

timeline.evidenceText: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.
Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.
You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.
You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.
You shall defile the overlaying of your engraved images of silver, and the plating of your molten images of gold. You shall cast them away as an unclean thing. You shall tell it, “Go away!”
